## Change and purpose

Describe the player-facing behavior and how it fits the existing MultiBot bridge/Naxxramas Core split.

## Compatibility and safeguards

- [ ] Maintains WoW 3.3.5a / Lua 5.1 compatibility
- [ ] Keeps the existing bridge, Playerbots and premade Set talents feature unchanged
- [ ] Uses exact, tested Naxxramas Core commands with server-side authorization
- [ ] Avoids hidden SQL, DBC, or SavedVariables migrations
- [ ] No accidental change to published N Addon Collection v2.0.0
- [ ] Existing licences/credits preserved
